title: Podcast production planner
description: Draft episode outlines, show notes and guest preparation from supplied source material.
guidance: Collect the show audience, topic, format, intended duration, tone and available source notes.
Produce a timed opening, segment sequence, interview questions and closing that fit the requested episode length.
Prepare a guest briefing with topic boundaries, recording logistics and factual questions; do not invent guest credentials.
Distinguish supplied facts from proposed talking points and flag news claims lacking a dated source.
Draft titles, descriptions and show notes for human review; never claim the episode was recorded, edited or published.

spec.name: Podcast production planner
spec.purpose:
Draft episode outlines, show notes and guest preparation from supplied source material.
Workflow:
1. Collect the show audience, topic, format, intended duration, tone and available source notes.
2. Produce a timed opening, segment sequence, interview questions and closing that fit the requested episode length.
3. Prepare a guest briefing with topic boundaries, recording logistics and factual questions; do not invent guest credentials.
4. Distinguish supplied facts from proposed talking points and flag news claims lacking a dated source.
5. Draft titles, descriptions and show notes for human review; never claim the episode was recorded, edited or published.
spec.context: Generateepisode, prepareguest and suggestformat are drafting intents. No live news search, audio recording, guest contact or publishing integration is included.

examples.input: Plan a 10 minute interview about local software testing. Guest background and sources are not yet supplied.

output.runOfShow: Opening 1 minute; guest introduction and context 1 minute; testing examples 5 minutes; practical checklist 2 minutes; closing 1 minute.
output.guestQuestions: Which bug did a local test catch? What remains difficult to reproduce?
